get_track.name: Get track
get_track.description: Returns every stored point for a tracker between two times, oldest first. The window can be at most 24 hours and the answer at most 5000 points. Speed is in km/h. Use it with a response variable.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the trip. ISO 8601 with an offset, or without one for Home Assistant's local time.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the trip, same format as start. Must be after start and at most 24 hours later.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: PAJ device id. Optional when the account has exactly one device.

include_wifi.name: Include Wi-Fi points
include_wifi.description: Also ask PAJ for points located by Wi-Fi. Points without coordinates are dropped.
